name: AgentPay
tagline: Agent-native API discovery, comparison, and x402 payment on Base.
mission: Give AI agents a clean catalog of paid APIs they can discover, price-check, and call through x402 without custom billing accounts.
workflow: Provider lists an API with schema, price, and Base receiving address.
Agent searches by task, price, latency, and health score.
x402 challenge is created for the selected API call.
Base Account approval unlocks the response and records a receipt.
